Committed suicide to defy the Dark Whisper, as shown in [[Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox]] |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=梧洛}} is a quest-exclusive NPC who makes her first appearance during the {{Quest|Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox}}. ==Profile== Wuluo was the leader of [[Xuanfang Wardens]] in holding the defense line around the [[Central Plains]] against [[Tacet Discord|Tacet Discords]]. She believed that the Sentinel [[Hsin]] the Moon Fox had abandoned her, as her prayer wasn't answered. She took on the [[Thundering Mephis]] by herself, when she was being manipulated by the Dark Whispher to beg for mercy. However, instead of succumbing to the manipulation, she decided to commit suicide to defy it. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Wuluo |zhs = 梧洛 |zht = 梧洛 |ja = 梧洛（ゴラク） |ko = 오낙 |fr = Wuluo |de = Wuluo |es = Wuluo |th = Wuluo |pt = Wuluo }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==References== {{Reflist}}
